scope.summary: The old target needs an update for g0002: it cannot reach the supported print rejection for a constructible chain of 1001 objects. The exact g0001 change and the delegated build recipe are unresolved; neither affects this established blocker.

assessments.reason: The supplied after-function shows an array print depth check, but no g0001 added/removed diff page identifies the exact change. The focused candidate concerns only object printing.
The new object print depth check rejects a valid, constructible deep object tree, but the target prints only a parsed tree. Parsing rejects the container needed to reach print depth 1000.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The parser rejects a container when its current depth reaches the limit.
The public constructor can create each object in the finite witness.
The public add operation attaches child objects without a depth check.
The supplied default nesting limit is 1000.

build.reason: The supplied harness build script delegates to fuzzing/ossfuzz.sh, whose contents are not supplied.

input.reason: A finite input with four valid flag bytes and a NUL-terminated JSON payload passes the entry guards and is passed to the parser; the parser accepts valid values.

evidence.dependency_reason: The parser processes the supplied payload and returns a parsed item on success.

lifecycle.reason: For successful parsing, the target frees any print result and deletes the parsed tree; the source uses default allocation hooks and frees print buffers on print failure.

evidence.dependency_reason: The source initializes its hooks to the standard allocators used by the target's free call.
The unbuffered print helper releases its buffers on failure.
cJSON_Delete releases the parsed tree and its owned contents.

control_flow.reason: Every target print call receives only the parser result. The parser's depth guard prevents that result from reaching the new object print guard.

evidence.dependency_reason: The parser rejects the 1001st nested object.
The changed guard requires print depth 1000 before processing the object.

blockers.requirement: Make the supported rejection of a constructible object at print depth 1000 reachable from the read target.
blockers.target_route: Four valid flag bytes and a NUL-terminated JSON payload enter cJSON_ParseWithOpts. On parse success, a flag selects cJSON_PrintBuffered, cJSON_Print, or cJSON_PrintUnformatted; each reaches print_value and then print_object for an object.
blockers.failure_condition: A finite chain of 1001 nested objects can be constructed and would reach print_object with depth 1000. The target cannot pass it to printing because cJSON_ParseWithOpts rejects the 1001st container and the target prints only the parser result.
blockers.alternative_paths: All three selected print calls receive the same parsed tree. Flag choices and trailing input do not deepen it; the later optional minify call acts on a separate byte copy and does not supply a tree to printing.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The public constructor creates object nodes for the finite witness.
The public add operation attaches named child objects without restricting their depth.
Parsing rejects an object once input depth reaches the limit.
The supplied default nesting limit is 1000.
Buffered printing starts with depth zero and calls print_value.
The other print variants start with depth zero and call print_value.
